extractions.value: Patient had autoimmune polyglandular syndrome (APS) type 2 (type 1 diabetes, Hashimoto's thyroiditis, anti-adrenal cortex antibodies) with coeliac disease. PERM symptoms present for approximately 6 years, which is longer than typical (usually death within 3 years). Rituximab led to marked and sustained improvement within 10 days of first cycle and 1 week after cycle 2.
